```{r}

#BiocManager::install("Biostrings")

library(Biostrings)

fasta_file <- "A16836270_mutant_seq.fa"  # Replace with your actual file path
sequences <- readDNAStringSet(fasta_file)
print(sequences)

first_seq <- sequences[[1]]
second_seq <- sequences[[2]]

wt_seq <- as.character(first_seq)
#print(seq_as_string1)

mut_seq <- as.character(second_seq)
#print(seq_as_string2)

```

```{r}
wt_chars <- strsplit(as.character(wt_seq), "")[[1]]
mut_chars <- strsplit(as.character(mut_seq), "")[[1]]

# Find positions where sequences differ
mut_positions <- which(wt_chars != mut_chars)

# Show differences
mutations <- data.frame(Position = mut_positions, WT = wt_chars[mut_positions], Mutant = mut_chars[mut_positions])
print(mutations)
```
